Thank you for taking the time to share your review — we really appreciate it.

We love how you described it as “a little bit of 50s America in Ho Chi Minh City” — that’s exactly what we’re aiming to bring to life every day.

At Eddie’s, we focus on good food and friendly service in a relaxed 1950s diner setting, with a huge menu of American comfort food — from all-day breakfast and epic burgers to New York deli sandwiches and our world-famous milkshakes. As to be expected..

For an american style diner, it was as to be expected. The portions were normal to large, the food was pretty good considering and my daughter loved the Sundae's, and yes that was a plural intentionally.

There are four menus which are a bit of a challenge to navigate, but once you get your head round it, there's a plethora of options.

It's great for fussy kids that don't want to eat the local food as there's plenty of western options.

𝒟𝑒𝒶𝓇 𝑀𝒶𝑔𝑔𝑜𝓉𝓈 𝐻𝒶𝓅𝓅𝑒𝓃,

Thank you again for your visit, and for taking the time to leave such a detailed and thoughtful review.

It’s good to hear we delivered what you’d expect from a classic 1950s American-style diner — good food and friendly service, generous portions, and plenty of choice for everyone at the table. We’re especially glad your daughter enjoyed the sundaes… always a good sign.

You’re absolutely right that the menus can feel like a lot at first. We’ve built Eddie’s around variety, which is why things are split across a few different menus — our classic New York diner and deli menu, a separate vegetarian offering under Shelley’s, our American-Chinese favorites, and a dedicated milkshakes, desserts and drinks menu. The milkshakes are world famous for a reason and might just be the best thing on the menu.

We also really appreciate you highlighting the family-friendly side of what we do. Being a place where both locals and visitors — especially families — can settle in comfortably is a big part of Eddie’s.

Thanks again for your visit, and we hope to welcome you back next time you’re in Ho Chi Minh City.

Disappointing returning visit
Mar 2026 • Friends
We’ve visited this diner a few times, latest being today. Always been excellent however today the burgers we ordered were cold, chips very hot. Too cold to eat and enjoy, after two bites I mentioned it to a staff member who took them away and said they’d cook fresh but would be waiting 10 mins, was ok with that. Second burgers were just the same, didn’t eat them, mentioned again to staff who apologised again and said they’d remove them from the bill. Really disappointing, certainly won’t be returning here!
Read more
Written March 16, 2026
Bws64
Dear Victoriaholly,

Hi, my name is Brad, one of the co-founders of Eddie’s. 

I was personally very sorry to read your TripAdvisor review, especially since you mentioned that you have visited us several times before. We truly appreciate those visits and are particularly disappointed that your most recent experience did not meet your expectations.

As you discovered, we do have a satisfaction guarantee. In fact, throughout our eight years of operation we have always stood behind the same simple promise: if a guest is not satisfied with their food or service, our team will do everything possible to make it right on the spot. I’m glad you alerted our staff to the issue so they could address it during your visit.

When you mentioned that the burger was not served at the temperature you expected, the team replaced it right away. When the second burger still did not meet your expectations, they removed the item from your bill.

Of course, we always prefer that things are right the first time. We appreciate you taking the time to share detailed feedback, and we will review what happened, including checking our dining room and kitchen video to better understand where things may have gone wrong and whether there is anything we need to tighten up operationally.

We serve hundreds of guests each week and this type of reported issue is very unusual for us, so we truly appreciate you bringing it to our attention.

If you are still in Saigon, I would very much appreciate the opportunity to personally invite you back to Eddie’s. Please do contact me directly at +84 903 962 400.

Regardless, I would still welcome the chance to speak with you and get a better understanding of your experience.

Warm regards,
Brad
Co-Founder
Eddie’s New York Diner & Deli
